candidates.description: This feature vector represents medical conditions, diseases, and health disorders.
This vector represents verbs of communication and attribution used to convey statements, claims, or findings.
This vector represents verbs and nouns associated with directional change, fluctuation, or growth and reduction.
This vector activates in contexts related to the COVID-19 pandemic and its societal impacts.
These tokens represent actions or interventions aimed at controlling, mitigating, or achieving specific outcomes.
This feature vector activates on words, roots, and suffixes related to the concept of infection and disease.
The vector represents immunological and biological medical concepts related to the immune system, treatments, and pathogens.
This feature represents the concept of variance, difference, and change among items.
This vector represents abstract nouns denoting potential outcomes, challenges, or attributes of a situation.
This feature vector represents the degree, intensity, or severity of conditions, actions, or changes.
